description: This Java class 'ProfesorService' implements core business logic for managing 'Profesor' entities in a Spring-based application. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, patching, and deleting 'Profesor' objects, using a 'ProfesorRepository' for persistence. The class also interacts with a data transfer object 'ProfesotDto' for creation purposes.

classes.name: ProfesorService
classes.description: Service class providing CRUD operations for 'Profesor' entities, acting as a bridge between controllers and repository layer.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new 'Profesor' entity from a data transfer object and persists it using the repository.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all 'Profesor' entities from the repository.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing 'Profesor' entity with new data.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Updates specific fields ('detalleProfesor') of an existing 'Profesor' entity.
